headerDisplay: Momentary switches that turn on for a moment when the Nuki lock is opened by fingerprint or keypad code. Uses a built-in MQTT broker by default — no Home Assistant or Mosquitto needed. Point the Nuki app's MQTT host to this Homebridge server's IP.

oneOf.title: External broker (e.g. Mosquitto in Home Assistant)

username.title: MQTT username
username.description: Built-in broker: the login the Nuki lock (and Home Assistant, if used) must enter. Leave empty for no login.

deviceId.title: Nuki device ID
deviceId.description: Shown in the MQTT topics, e.g. nuki/4E2CC127/state. Optional with the built-in broker (learned from the first message).

codeIds.title: Only these Code IDs (optional, per person)
codeIds.description: Leave empty for everyone. Code IDs appear in the Homebridge log.

enabled.title: Show the keypad as its own accessory
enabled.description: A button with a battery: single press = fingerprint, double press = code. The Nuki only reports whether the keypad battery is low (no percentage), so Home shows 100% or 10% and a low-battery warning.

childLock.title: Child lock (disable the button on the lock)

enabled.title: Show a child-lock switch
enabled.description: Turns the physical button on the Smart Lock off and on through the Nuki Web API (cloud). Needs Nuki Web enabled for the lock, its PIN entered in web.nuki.io, and an API token.

token.title: Nuki Web API token
token.description: web.nuki.io → API → Generate API token. Rights: View devices, View and edit devices, Manage device configuration.

smartlockId.title: Smart Lock ID (optional)
smartlockId.description: Found automatically from the Nuki device ID.

doorLock.title: Matter door lock with door position (for iOS 27.2 "Lock After Closing")

enabled.title: Enable the Matter door lock
enabled.description: Runs a standalone Matter lock (own pairing code) that reports the door position. Lock/unlock commands go to the Nuki over MQTT — enable lock actions in the Nuki app's MQTT settings.

doorSwitchName.title: Door-state switch name
doorSwitchName.description: A HomeKit switch the door position comes from. Create two Home automations: door sensor opens → turn this switch on; door sensor closes → turn it off.

lockAfterCloseSeconds.title: Lock after closing (seconds, plugin fallback)
lockAfterCloseSeconds.description: Optional. Lock this many seconds after the door closes while unlocked. Leave empty to rely only on the setting in the Home app (Matter auto-relock time).

passcode.title: Matter setup passcode
passcode.description: 8 digits. Changing it after pairing has no effect.
